summary: A broad sell-off in AI-linked stocks hit US equities on Nov 20; CNN reported the Nasdaq fell 5.28% and erased its gains for the year as investors moved into bonds. Nvidia reported a Q3 revenue beat ($115.8B, +103% YoY), but its board said it would not reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, and the stock fell sharply. Bitcoin dropped to just under $60,000, more than 50% below its all-time high. Brent and WTI were on track for a third straight weekly decline as Hormuz crude flows normalised, and gold also fell.
